name: Longbarrel howitzer S4
description: An oversized slug thrower bolted to a turret ring. It is loud and accurate enough.

name: Longbarrel howitzer S5
description: The largest slug thrower the Reach has built. It kicks hard enough to move a frigate.

name: Boomtown plasma mortar S4
description: A slow, glowing plasma ball lobbed over long range. Crews say it hits like a barn falling on you.

name: Boomtown plasma mortar S5
description: A heavy plasma mortar fed from a salvaged reactor. It is slow, bright and difficult to ignore.

name: Hailstorm flak rotary S4
description: A big rotary flak gun that throws out a curtain of bursting shells against anything small and fast.

name: Powder-keg torpedo launcher S5
description: A slow torpedo with a huge warhead and a short fuse that is trusted by nobody but its crew.

name: Hornet missile rack S1
description: A small homing missile on a light rack, bolted to a fighter's wing with a few welds.

name: Hornet missile rack S2
description: Two homing missiles on a single rail. Not pretty, but it works.
